lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Reward: Police Badge ×2

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We made a lot of progress today.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You're a natural in the Raptocamo at this point,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: nearly indistinguishable from an actual Rapture.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I think it's time we take these suits out for a spin!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Are you excited about this once-in-a-lifetime experience?
I'm ready to go.
I'm still a little hesitant.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Good!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hahaha! Nothing wrong with that!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Don't worry, the Raptures and I are the best of friends.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: So long as you're with me,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: you have nothing to worry about!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The Raptures are all starving at this point, so they'll be acting irrationally.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We'll wait until they've had their fill and calmed down.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That way, they'll be calm, relaxed, and collected

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: even with a stranger like you in their midst.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll be in touch when the time is right.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Take care of yourself until then.
